thesis.en: AI systems that surpass human intelligence in most economically valuable tasks, including reasoning and multi-step planning.
thesis.zhHans: 系统在绝大多数具备经济价值的任务中达到超越人类的智能水平，包含抽象推理与多步规划能力。

description.en: AI systems that surpass human intelligence in most economically valuable tasks, including reasoning and multi-step planning.
description.zhHans: 系统在绝大多数具备经济价值的任务中达到超越人类的智能水平，包含抽象推理与多步规划能力。

assumptions: Resolution criteria are provisional and should be refined when source-backed forecasts are added.

achievedWhen.en: An AI system demonstrates broad autonomous capability across knowledge work, software, scientific reasoning, and multi-step planning under multiple independent evaluations and real workflows for at least 90 days.
achievedWhen.zhHans: 在多个独立评测和真实工作流中，系统持续展现跨知识工作、软件、科学推理和多步规划的广泛自主能力，并可被第三方复核至少 90 天。

notAchievedWhen.en: A closed demo, a single benchmark result, hidden human handoff, or unverifiable claim does not count.
notAchievedWhen.zhHans: 仅有封闭演示、单一 benchmark 高分、隐藏人工接管或不可复核声明时，不算达成。

thesis.en: Humanoid robots powered by general physical intelligence performing domestic chores and manufacturing labor at scale.
thesis.zhHans: 具备通用物理智能的人形机器人，可进入家庭执行家务，或在制造业和物流中进行规模化自主替代劳作。

description.en: Humanoid robots powered by general physical intelligence performing domestic chores and manufacturing labor at scale.
description.zhHans: 具备通用物理智能的人形机器人，可进入家庭执行家务，或在制造业和物流中进行规模化自主替代劳作。

assumptions: Resolution criteria are provisional and should be refined when source-backed forecasts are added.

achievedWhen.en: General embodied systems reliably complete multiple task classes in homes, manufacturing, or logistics, with sustained commercially deployable use cases.
achievedWhen.zhHans: 通用具身系统在家庭、制造或物流等非结构化环境中稳定完成多类任务，并出现可商业部署的持续使用案例。

notAchievedWhen.en: A lab-only demo, teleoperated video, or success on a single task does not count.
notAchievedWhen.zhHans: 只在实验室演示、遥操作视频或单一任务上成功，不算达成。

thesis.en: Solving the control and alignment problem of artificial systems that are orders of magnitude smarter than humans.
thesis.zhHans: 彻底解决比人类更聪明数个数量级的超智能（ASI）控制和价值观绑定问题，消除潜在失控性生存危机。

description.en: Solving the control and alignment problem of artificial systems that are orders of magnitude smarter than humans.
description.zhHans: 彻底解决比人类更聪明数个数量级的超智能（ASI）控制和价值观绑定问题，消除潜在失控性生存危机。

assumptions: Resolution criteria are provisional and should be refined when source-backed forecasts are added.

achievedWhen.en: Control, alignment, and failure-handling methods for systems materially stronger than humans are independently audited and remain effective in real deployment.
achievedWhen.zhHans: 面向明显强于人类的系统，出现被独立审计认可的控制、对齐和失效处置框架，并在真实部署中持续有效。

notAchievedWhen.en: Principle statements, a single safety benchmark, or an undeployed research prototype do not count.
notAchievedWhen.zhHans: 只有原则声明、单项安全评测或未经部署验证的研究原型，不算达成。

thesis.en: AI systems becoming autonomous scientific pioneers, generating novel theories and unlocking scalable fusion energy.
thesis.zhHans: AI 系统成为科学研究的引领者，自主设计实验、推导物理学或生命科学定律，甚至完成可控核聚变规模商用。

description.en: AI systems becoming autonomous scientific pioneers, generating novel theories and unlocking scalable fusion energy.
description.zhHans: AI 系统成为科学研究的引领者，自主设计实验、推导物理学或生命科学定律，甚至完成可控核聚变规模商用。

assumptions: Resolution criteria are provisional and should be refined when source-backed forecasts are added.

achievedWhen.en: AI systems autonomously propose verifiable hypotheses, design experiments, and drive at least one independently confirmed discovery in a major scientific field.
achievedWhen.zhHans: AI 系统自主提出可验证科学假设、设计实验并推动至少一个重要领域产生被独立确认的新发现。

notAchievedWhen.en: Drafting papers, assisting analysis, or proposing unverified hypotheses does not count.
notAchievedWhen.zhHans: 仅生成论文草稿、辅助分析数据或提出未验证假设，不算达成。
